## Intro
This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to retrieve data from the EMG (Electromyography) sensor of a Teslasuit device. The page is structured to help developers understand the process of initializing the Teslasuit API, connecting to a device, accessing the EMG subsystem, and streaming data.

## Code for EMG data
````python
import time
from teslasuit_sdk import ts_api

# Streaming parameters
DESIRED_FPS      = 60              # target data polling rate in frames per second
PERIOD_S         = 1.0 / DESIRED_FPS  # seconds to wait between each read
FRAMES_TO_STREAM = 10              # number of frames to capture before stopping

def main():
    print("Initializing Teslasuit API...")
    api = ts_api.TsApi()  # create the central API object

    print("Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...")
    device = api.get_device_manager().get_or_wait_last_device_attached()

    print("Accessing the EMG subsystem...")
    emg = device.emg  # EMG subsystem exposes raw muscle-activity sensor data

    print("Starting EMG data streaming...")
    emg.start_streaming()

    print("Streaming EMG data...")
    frames_remaining = FRAMES_TO_STREAM
    while frames_remaining > 0:
        time.sleep(PERIOD_S)              # throttle polling to the desired FPS
        print("EMG data:", emg.get_data_on_ready())
        frames_remaining -= 1

    print("Stopping EMG data streaming...")
    emg.stop_streaming()
    print("Finished")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...
Accessing the EMG subsystem...
